title: work gloves tied inside a trash sack
body: Leather gloves sit inside a knotted trash sack. Mustard-colored crop dust coats the cuffs, while the outside remains clean.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while crossing treated land; the personal trace does not by itself prove the farm program caused the emergency.
gloss: A personal trace links farm-program residue to symptoms before a restriction.
